mapper.insert: INSERT INTO company_profile ( member_id, company_name, business_number, representative_name, industry, company_address, company_detail_address, company_phone, website_url, logo_url, company_description, employee_count, established_date, verification_status ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{companyName}, #{businessNumber}, #{representativeName}, #{industry}, #{companyAddress}, #{companyDetailAddress}, #{companyPhone}, #{websiteUrl}, #{logoUrl}, #{companyDescription}, #{employeeCount}, #{establishedDate}, 'PENDING' )
mapper.select: SELECT id, member_id, company_name, business_number, representative_name, industry, company_address, company_detail_address, company_phone, website_url, logo_url, company_description, employee_count, established_date, verification_status, created_at, updated_at FROM company_profile WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
